note: a red|green texture modulated by a white|blue one: channel 1 flipped (left quad) or not (right quad); the coordinates of each channel pick the texels
gaps: the picture is made once, in the first channel's coordinates; channel i is carried as the affine map that takes channel 0 to channel i (least squares over the vertices): exact for a quad or any planar mapping, the nearest affine map otherwise (noted on the page)
the X3D 4.0 use of a MultiTextureCoordinate, where a material names a channel by its `mapping`, is the Library hall port's (hall/body-hl.js) and is not part of the bridge body
